steps.content: The church is located near the square. Villagers come here to pray and confess their troubles and sins to the Clergyman.
As you enter the church, you grow cautious, realizing that this Clergyman, just like the Butcher, has established his own "base" within the village.
There are few people at this hour. Only the Clergyman is standing in the spacious church. Unlike the foggy outdoors, the light here seems exceptionally soft and bright.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think you're smart, so I'll cut to the chase. This isn't just a normal game.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You know that sealing the hot spring could delay the Butcher's resurrection, and you know that taking away his ax would subdue him. You seem to know quite a lot about this bizarre game.
The Clergyman doesn't deny it. He pushes his glasses up, his voice soft, as if deliberately drawing your attention to his words.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Perhaps... you would like to hear the Butcher's story in another world?

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: I'm not excusing his actions. I just want you to understand... how he became the way he is.

options: Could you tell me about it?
That's exactly what I came here for.

steps.content: [Insert special portrait - Old sheriff's badge]

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: In that world, he was once a worthless auxiliary officer. He maintained order, wrote reports, patrolled at night, sometimes even helped look for lost cats, and walked dogs. Because of his background, he wasn't even given a permanent position.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Later, he lost his job and had no choice but to work as a security guard at a store.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: During the war, some hooligans vandalized and robbed the store. His boss berated him for failing his duty and fired him. Once again, he had nowhere to go.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Heh, who knows if it was just an excuse to cut costs during that post-war period? But the Butcher didn't understand that. He only saw himself as a discarded object, unable to hold even a regular security guard job.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: In the post-war economy, the only "job" he could find was probably this role in the game of the Witch.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Even if it's just a role in a story, a "Butcher" who protects the villagers and hunts down the Witch. As long as someone still needs him and believes in him, he will pour his entire heart into it, desperately trying to prove his worth.
[Insert Flashback]

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Ha! The mightiest butcher, the Protector of Cirrenfold, is setting out!
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Are you scared? That's normal. With me here, you don't need to be afraid.
[End of Flashback]
You recall that before the Butcher became insane, he indeed always talked about "protecting" others.

Perhaps the Witch targeted the Butcher precisely because of his unfulfilled urge to do his job well and protect others. This obsession was exploited by the Witch, allowing Mania to take advantage of his vulnerability and take control.

The master of this illusion has planted an undetectable "Mania bomb" in Eastside's busiest district. You have no idea when it might detonate. If left unchecked, there will always be the next "Butcher."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you truly pity and empathize with everyone, then surely you've witnessed people slaughtering each other in every round, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This loop of agony needs to end. I don't believe you're someone who enjoys killing and madness. Otherwise, you wouldn't have left flowers for the Butcher or shared his story with me.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: This is just a game.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This isn't just a game. They've used special methods to make it "real." You know there's an actual supernatural Witch here. Someone dangerous and arrogant, who blesses everyone with the name tags while simultaneously toying with them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you're truly the Butcher's friend, then you should think about what's best for him!
You withhold crucial information about Mania while cautiously extending an olive branch to the Clergyman. He remains silent for a moment, seemingly contemplating the speech you just delivered.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: No wonder you managed to defeat the Butcher and walk away with his ax without a scratch.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: So this game is truly that dangerous. I always thought something was off... The rules of this world seemed too detached from reality. I had no idea there were such secrets behind it all.
You nod, your gaze toward the Clergyman more sincere now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whether it's the Butcher, you, or me, none of us should be killing each other. Our true enemy is that Witch hiding within the story, manipulating everyone's minds.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Otherwise, there will always be another Butcher, another player driven to madness.
The Clergyman fiddles with his collar, lowering his head with a smile.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: I was right about you. You really are different from everyone else.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: No wonder you managed to snatch the Butcher's ax. From that moment, I've been certain you must possess a different kind of power.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: ...So the goal is to destroy this story. I understand now. I'll help you.
(Scene change)
Outside the church, Eleanor is waiting for you both. You exchange a glance with the Clergyman before sharing your theories about the main quest with her.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: An alliance?! Capture the evil Witch?!

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: I thought the Witch was just some background lore in this story. So she's a real person? Oh, I love this plot twist! Count me in!
